```yaml
name: Check Discord Link

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get current Discord invite code
        id: get_code
        run: |
          # Extract invite code from the new link
          echo "invite_code=f2AjwV2AN" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Check Discord invite link
        id: check_invite
        run: |
          INVITE_CODE=${{ env.invite_code }}
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /tmp/response.txt "https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/$INVITE_CODE")
          echo "response_code=$RESPONSE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          cat /tmp/response.txt | jq -e '.code == "'$INVITE_CODE'"' > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "valid=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV || echo "valid=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create issue if link is invalid
        if: env.valid != 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: issues } = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: ['discord-link']
            });

            if (issues.length === 0) {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                title: 'Discord invite link is invalid',
                body: 'The Discord invite link is no longer valid. Please verify and update the link.\n\nCurrent invite code: f2AjwV2AN',
                labels: ['discord-link']
              });
            }
```
